title: Work Lights
headline: Replaces up to 400W HID.
intro: Super bright and durable, our LED work site lights reduce costs and labor with integrated power cord and daisy-chain feature. Several wattages and connection options to choose from will make lighting any work site easier than ever.

features.label: 3-prong plug (NEMA 5-15P / grounded outlet)

features.note: Canadian flag beside the table; its bracket arrows point at the LED-9011-50K-G3 and LED-9003-50K-10PK-163-G3 rows

features.label: UL Type B ballast bypass
features.note: LED-9210-50K-G2 only (High Bay Work Site Lights | Ballast Bypass | Type B table)

tables.title: Temporary Work Site Lights
rows: 3-prong plug; Approved for use in Canada
notes: Merged cells: 120V spans all four rows; 400W HID / 100W / 15,000 / 6.0 in x 10.1 in span the 9010-9012 rows; 5000K and the 3-prong plug glyph span all four rows; the ETL mark is printed for row 1, for rows 2-3 (merged) and for row 4
The 'Approved for use in Canada' flag sits outside the table with arrows at the LED-9011 and LED-9003-...-163 rows; see footnotes

tables.title: High Bay Work Site Lights | Ballast Bypass | Type B
rows: 6 ft power cord w/ stripped leads

tables.title: Temporary Work Site String Lights
rows: 3-prong plug; Approved for use in Canada
notes: Merged cells: 120V, 900W INC, 130W (10 X 13W), 16000/STRING, 5000K and 4.4 in x 3.1 in span both rows; the plug glyph differs per row (3-prong for the 16/3 cord, 2-prong for the 18/2 cord)
Wattage is printed on two lines: '130W' and '(10 X 13W)'; lumens printed as '16000/STRING'
